§6Fluid Ores§f

§aOres that drop fluids, handle with care!§f

These special ores release their fluids when mined. §bOil Sand§f appears in deserts (§eY 10-80§f) and drops Bitumen plus Crude Oil. The magical variants, §bDestabilized Redstone Ore§f (Overworld, §eY 0-20§f), §bEnergized Netherrack§f (Nether), and §bResonant End Stone§f (End), drop clathrates that melt to their respective fluids in a §bMagma Crucible§f.

Melt the ore block for §e1,000 mB§f of fluid; clathrates give §e250 mB§f. You can solidify clathrates back using §bCryotheum Dust§f in a Fluid Transposer. Destabilized Redstone is useful for Signalum crafting later, so stockpile some.

§ePS:§f Silk Touch collects the ore block without spilling its fluid, very handy for storage.
